description: Aligns the existing TanStack Start monolith to serve the mobile template. This is a backend-only spec. No mobile code changes. The monolith already has better-auth, Prisma/Postgres, tRPC, and most auth routes. This spec documents exactly what exists, what is broken for mobile, and what needs to be added or changed. Work is done entirely in the TanStack Start repo.

what_works_for_mobile: better-auth handles /api/auth/* routes via catch-all handler — POST sign-in, sign-up, forgot-password, reset-password all work out of the box
User model has all required fields: id, email, firstname, lastname, role, emailVerified, status, createdAt, updatedAt
Session model has token and expiresAt — mobile can use token as Bearer
tRPC router exists at /trpc with superjson transformer — mobile already calls this
user.updateProfile tRPC procedure exists and works
admin.listUsers tRPC procedure exists with role check
Role enum exists on User — maps to mobile tab config
Status enum exists on User — maps to mobile account locked detection
emailVerification plugin active — mobile OTP/verify flow maps to this

what_is_broken_for_mobile.issue: Cookie-based auth only — tanstackStartCookies plugin sets httpOnly cookies
what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: CRITICAL — React Native cannot use httpOnly cookies. Mobile gets 401 on all authenticated calls.
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Add bearerAuth plugin to better-auth config. Mobile sends Authorization: Bearer <token>. Web continues using cookies.

what_is_broken_for_mobile.issue: protectedProcedure reads session from cookie headers only
what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: CRITICAL — tRPC calls from mobile with Bearer token fail auth check
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Update protectedProcedure to check Authorization header first, fall back to cookie session

what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: HIGH — Mobile dev client on physical device (different IP) gets CORS errors
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Add CORS headers in TanStack Start server config for mobile dev IPs and production domain

what_is_broken_for_mobile.issue: Password reset uses email link, not 6-digit OTP code
what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: MEDIUM — Mobile MVP 2 spec assumes OTP code entry screen. Email link opens a browser, not the app.
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Two options: (A) Use better-auth's built-in reset link — mobile opens browser to reset, then returns to app. (B) Add custom OTP endpoint. Recommendation: Option A for template simplicity — document in spec.

what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: HIGH — Mobile MVP 4 boot sequence calls this for maintenance mode and force update check
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Add new TanStack Start API route at /api/app/config

what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: MEDIUM — Mobile MVP 3 delete account screen has no backend
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Add user.deleteAccount procedure to user router

what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: MEDIUM — Mobile MVP 3 change password screen has no backend
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Add user.changePassword procedure to user router — uses better-auth changePassword API

what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: LOW — Only needed for private channels in MVP 5

what_is_broken_for_mobile.issue: Seed file is empty (only reads users)
what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: LOW — No test data with different roles to verify mobile role-based nav
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: Update prisma/seed.ts to create USER, ADMIN, MODERATOR test accounts

what_is_broken_for_mobile.issue: emailVerified check in assertAuthenticatedFn redirects to /verify-email (web route)
what_is_broken_for_mobile.impact: MEDIUM — Mobile has its own verify email flow. Backend must not block token issuance on emailVerified.
what_is_broken_for_mobile.fix: better-auth issues the session token regardless of emailVerified. The emailVerified check is only in web server functions (assertAuthenticatedFn) — not in the auth handler itself. Mobile handles this client-side by checking emailVerified in the session response.

password_reset_decision.recommendation: Option A — Email link reset (keep existing better-auth behavior)
rationale: better-auth's built-in reset link is secure, tested, and zero additional code
Mobile flow: user taps forgot password → enters email → receives link → taps link → opens browser → resets password → returns to app
This is standard practice for mobile apps (Spotify, Notion, Linear all do this)
Option B (custom OTP) requires: custom DB table, OTP generation, expiry logic, rate limiting — significant scope for a template
Mobile MVP 2 spec OTP screen should be scoped to email verification only, not password reset
password_reset_decision.mobile_spec_impact: MVP 2 OTP screen is removed from password reset flow. Forgot password → email link → browser reset. Mobile only shows forgot-password email entry screen, then a success message 'Check your email for a reset link'.
password_reset_decision.otp_screen_remains_for: Email verification after sign-up — better-auth sends verification email, user taps link, emailVerified becomes true. Mobile can show a 'Check your email' screen after sign-up.

changes.why: Enables mobile to authenticate via Authorization: Bearer <token> header
changes.how: Import { bearer } from 'better-auth/plugins' and add to plugins array alongside tanstackStartCookies

changes.why: Physical Android device on same network hits CORS. Dev IP must be trusted.
changes.how: Add env.MOBILE_DEV_URL to trustedOrigins array. Example: 'http://192.168.1.x:3000'

changes.what: Add deleteUser plugin or configure user deletion
changes.why: better-auth does not expose delete account by default
changes.how: Use auth.api.deleteUser in the tRPC procedure — no plugin needed, it is a built-in API method

changes.what: Update protectedProcedure to support Bearer token from Authorization header
changes.why: Mobile sends Bearer token in header. Current implementation only reads cookie session.
changes.how: In protectedProcedure middleware: check ctx.headers for Authorization header. If present, call auth.api.getSession with those headers. better-auth bearer plugin handles extraction automatically — no manual token parsing needed.

files_to_modify.note: The bearer plugin patches auth.api.getSession to recognize Authorization headers automatically. No change to protectedProcedure logic needed IF the bearer plugin is added to better-auth config. Verify this works with a test call after adding the plugin.

changes.endpoint_logic: Call auth.api.changePassword({ body: { currentPassword, newPassword }, headers: ctx.headers })
changes.error_handling: Catch better-auth error for wrong current password — return 400 with INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD code

changes.endpoint_logic: 1. Verify password via auth.api.signInWithEmailAndPassword first. 2. If valid: call auth.api.deleteUser({ headers: ctx.headers }). 3. This invalidates all sessions automatically.
changes.error_handling: Catch wrong password — return 400 with INVALID_PASSWORD code

changes.what: Add MOBILE_DEV_URL and APP_VERSION env vars
changes.why: CORS trusted origin for physical Android device. APP_VERSION for /api/app/config response.

changes.what: Add seeded test users with all roles
changes.why: Mobile needs to test role-based tab navigation. Currently no seed data.
changes.how: Use auth.api.signUpEmail to create users so better-auth properly hashes passwords and creates sessions. Then update role and status via prisma.user.update after creation.

files_to_create.description: App config endpoint. Called by mobile on cold start before auth bootstrap. Returns maintenance mode, version info. No auth required.

response_shape.maintenanceMessage: string | null — from MAINTENANCE_MESSAGE env var

files_to_create.implementation: TanStack Start createFileRoute at '/api/app/config' with GET server handler. Read env vars, return JSON response.
files_to_create.note: MAINTENANCE_MODE env var is string 'true'/'false' — parse to boolean in response

files_to_create.description: Pusher private channel auth endpoint. Called by mobile Pusher client to authenticate private-user-{userId} channels.
implementation: Import Pusher server SDK: import Pusher from 'pusher'
Initialize Pusher with PUSHER_APP_ID, VITE_PUSHER_KEY, PUSHER_APP_SECRET, VITE_PUSHER_CLUSTER from env
Verify session from Authorization header (bearer plugin)
Validate channel_name starts with 'private-user-' + session.user.id — prevent subscribing to other users' channels
If channel_name doesn't match user's channel: return 403

files_to_create.description: Dev-only endpoint to trigger seed. Only active when NODE_ENV=development. Returns 404 in production.
files_to_create.implementation: Check NODE_ENV — if production return 404. Run seed logic and return created user list.
files_to_create.guard: if (env.NODE_ENV !== 'development') return new Response('Not found', { status: 404 })

files_to_create.description: Dev-only endpoint to toggle maintenance mode without env restart. Stores state in memory (process-level). Resets on server restart.
files_to_create.note: In-memory toggle only — not persisted. For real maintenance, set MAINTENANCE_MODE env var and restart.

mobile_adapter_alignment.description: How the mobile better-auth adapter maps to the monolith endpoints after these changes

endpoint_mapping.response_mobile_needs: { token, user: { id, email, firstname, lastname, role } }
endpoint_mapping.response_monolith_returns: better-auth returns session with token field
endpoint_mapping.gap: better-auth sign-in response includes token in session object — mobile adapter must extract session.token
endpoint_mapping.mobile_adapter_note: In better-auth.adapter.ts: response.token comes from response.session?.token or response.token depending on better-auth version. Log the raw response during development to confirm shape.

endpoint_mapping.response_mobile_needs: { user: { id, email, firstname, lastname, role } }

endpoint_mapping.gap: None — better-auth sign-out invalidates the session token

endpoint_mapping.note: better-auth endpoint is forget-password (no 't') — confirm exact path from better-auth docs
endpoint_mapping.gap: Returns email link, not OTP. Mobile shows success message only — no OTP entry screen for password reset.

endpoint_mapping.monolith_endpoint: No explicit refresh endpoint in better-auth
endpoint_mapping.gap: IMPORTANT — better-auth sessions are long-lived (7 days) with cookieCache (1 hour). For mobile Bearer tokens, the token IS the session token and expires in 7 days. No refresh needed. Mobile should store token expiry (expiresAt from session) and treat 401 as re-login signal rather than attempting refresh.
endpoint_mapping.mobile_spec_impact: Remove TOKEN_REFRESH_KEY from secureStore. Simplify session lifecycle: token valid → use it. Token 401 → SessionExpiredModal → re-login. No silent refresh.

endpoint_mapping.gap: None — works after bearer plugin addition
Procedure does not exist yet — created in this spec
Procedure does not exist yet — created in this spec

account_locked_mapping.description: Mobile MVP 2 detects account locked from a specific error code. Map monolith's STATUS enum to mobile error.
account_locked_mapping.mobile_detection: When sign-in returns status INACTIVE/LOCKED: better-auth returns 403 or custom error. Mobile checks response status/error code.
account_locked_mapping.implementation: Add custom error in better-auth config or handle in the sign-in flow. Alternatively: if user.status !== 'ACTIVE', better-auth can be configured to reject sign-in. Check better-auth docs for account status hooks.
account_locked_mapping.simplest_approach: In better-auth config, add account.accountLinking or use the databaseHooks.session.create hook to check user.status before creating session. Return error if status is not ACTIVE.

cors_configuration.description: TanStack Start uses Vinxi/H3 under the hood. CORS must be configured at the server level.

implementation.package: h3 (already a dependency via TanStack Start)
implementation.approach: Add CORS headers via TanStack Start's server config in vite.config.ts

env_additions.description: New env vars to add to .env file in monolith repo

development.MOBILE_DEV_URL: http://192.168.1.x:3000 — replace with your local network IP

session_lifetime_decision.description: Critical alignment between monolith session config and mobile expectations
mobile_impact: Token (= session token) expires in 7 days — mobile stores this as TOKEN_EXPIRY_KEY
No refresh token needed — token is valid for 7 days, then user must re-login
cookieCache is irrelevant for mobile Bearer auth
Mobile boot sequence: if token exists and not expired (< 7 days old) → call /api/auth/get-session to validate → if 401 → re-login
session_lifetime_decision.mobile_spec_change: Remove REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY from secureStore spec. Remove adapter.refresh() from AuthAdapter interface. Session expiry = 7 days. 401 = full re-login via SessionExpiredModal.

acceptance_criteria.given: Mobile sends POST /api/auth/sign-in/email with email and password
acceptance_criteria.then: Response includes token and user with id, email, firstname, lastname, role

acceptance_criteria.given: Mobile sends GET /api/auth/get-session with Authorization: Bearer <token>
acceptance_criteria.then: Response includes user object with role field

acceptance_criteria.given: Mobile sends tRPC call to user.updateProfile with Authorization: Bearer <token>
acceptance_criteria.then: Profile is updated and new user data returned — no cookie required
Response: { maintenanceMode: false, maintenanceMessage: null, minimumVersion: '1.0.0', currentVersion: '1.0.0' }
Response: { maintenanceMode: true, maintenanceMessage: '...', ... } — mobile shows MaintenanceModeScreen

acceptance_criteria.given: Mobile signs in as admin@test.com after seed
acceptance_criteria.then: user.role = 'ADMIN' — mobile renders admin tab in bottom nav
Response returns error that maps to account locked — mobile shows AccountLockedScreen

acceptance_criteria.given: Mobile sends tRPC user.deleteAccount with correct password
acceptance_criteria.then: User and all sessions deleted. Subsequent calls with old token return 401.

acceptance_criteria.given: Physical Android device on local network sends request to monolith
acceptance_criteria.when: MOBILE_DEV_URL is set to the device's network IP

out_of_scope: Email provider integration (Resend, Nodemailer) — dev uses console.log logging of links, production setup is app-level
Rate limiting on auth endpoints — important for production but not in template scope. Add note in SECURITY_CHECKLIST.md
SSL/HTTPS setup — handled at deployment level (Railway, Fly.io, etc.)
WebSocket/Pusher server events — template provides the auth endpoint. Apps add their own event triggers.
Web session behavior changes — tanstackStartCookies remains for web. Bearer is additive only.
Role management UI — admin.listUsers already exists. Role assignment is direct DB operation for now.

testing_sequence.description: Step-by-step sequence to verify mobile ↔ monolith integration works after applying this spec
steps: 1. Run prisma/seed.ts — verify 4 test users created in DB
5. Test: sign in as user@test.com — verify home screen loads with 'Hello, Test 👋'
6. Test: sign in as admin@test.com — verify admin tab appears in bottom nav
7. Test: sign in as locked@test.com — verify AccountLockedScreen appears
8. Test: GET http://<ip>:3000/api/app/config in browser — verify JSON response
9. Test: set MAINTENANCE_MODE=true in .env, restart monolith — verify mobile shows MaintenanceModeScreen
10. Test: turn off monolith server — verify mobile shows ServerErrorScreen
11. Test: turn off wifi on device — verify mobile shows NoInternetScreen on launch
12. Test: update profile from mobile — verify name changes in DB
13. Test: change password from mobile — verify new password works on next sign-in
14. Test: delete account from mobile — verify user removed from DB
